overview: The Civic Auditoriums and Convention Center Commission reviewed ongoing facility maintenance, discussed prioritizing safety and egress improvements at the Chevalier Theatre, and received updates on upcoming events and capital projects.

items.title: Friends of the Chevalier Annual Meeting Recap
items.summary: Cindy Watson recapped the Friends of Chevalier annual meeting, highlighting strong community turnout, support for youth programming, and an upcoming website redesign.

items.title: Chevalier Theatre Organ Society Update
items.summary: Ken Krause reported on the Organ Society's annual meeting and noted that organ installation work is temporarily paused while contractor Peter Rudowitz recovers from an injury.

items.title: Commission Vacancy
items.summary: Chair Mike Oliver announced a vacancy on the commission following Perry Brand's departure and requested applications from Medford residents, ideally with grant-writing experience.

items.title: Facility Maintenance and Capital Projects Update
items.summary: Facilities Director David McIntyre reported completion of bathroom LED lighting and diesel tank replacements, while updates were provided on marquee engineering drawings, stair carpeting, and building assessment funding.

items.title: Theater Safety and Egress Priorities
items.summary: The commission reviewed a prioritized list of safety issues—including balcony lighting, emergency exit access, stairwell ceiling panels, and loading ramp repairs—and supported hiring a code consultant to perform a comprehensive facility audit.

items.title: Recreation Center Gym Renovations
items.summary: David McIntyre announced that the City Council approved $85,000 for schematic drawings for recreation center gym repairs, with engineering walk-throughs already underway.

items.title: Upcoming Events and Management Contract
items.summary: Theater management announced upcoming concerts, including the Ronnie Wood Band, and inquired about the status of the venue's long-pending management contract with the city.
